source: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy and Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
about: Every article in the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (plato.stanford.edu) and the Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy (iep.utm.edu): free, peer-reviewed survey articles on philosophy, logic, foundations of mathematics, philosophy of science, ethics, political and social thought, decision theory and individual philosophers.
collected: SEP: every entry link on https://plato.stanford.edu/contents.html, with title (citation_title meta) and authors (citation_author meta) read from each entry page; IEP: every article link on the A-Z index pages https://iep.utm.edu/a/ through https://iep.utm.edu/z/, with title and author (Author Information section) read from each article page. Topics come from the title, top-level table-of-contents headings, SEP related entries and IEP categories. Fetched 2026-11-11.
